game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Sundial Plaza Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza, a giant sundial plaza: the desert nomad must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza: a giant sundial plaza
core_gameplay_loop: In Sundial Plaza, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the bazaar gate using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The bazaar gate reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the bazaar gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sundial Plaza'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Sundial Plaza.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The bazaar gate reached with actions_used <= 14.
